This small, cubical '''shuttle''' served as the personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The vessel was painted [[Color/Legends|white]] and red and sported a tail fin along with landing gear and a boarding ramp. It was capable of both space and atmospheric flight. Some time during that war, Jettster piloted the vessel to [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dractu]] in search of [[Dractuvian cave slug]]s. After locating and capturing them, Jettster returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and served them to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who considered them the best dish of the planet's unappetizing cuisine.<ref name="AFA" />
